xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF ingested from GitHub issue #5885

plan.title: Self-repair never discloses preserved managed git hooks (follow-up to #5837)

narratives.Description: Self-repair never discloses preserved managed git hooks (follow-up to #5837)
narratives.Overview: Prefer-A Recut-2 Bound 6393572833: maybeSelfCompleteSetup discloses preserved managed hooks on stderr once per process; force/refuse fixture reaches downgrade via rel-keyed next-body seam; e2e covers preserve, empty conflicts, readiness, unchanged hook bytes.
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive operator running check/self-repair, I want preserved tracked managed git hooks disclosed on stderr with the same wording as explicit setup, so I know a divergent hook was kept without parsing silent discard.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Add optional writeErr on maybeSelfCompleteSetup (default process.stderr.write); emit each formatTrackedHookPreserved line at most once per process keyed on emitted preserved lines; export once-guard reset for tests; never writeOut/stdout; wire bin.ts and hook-dispatch via seams.writeErr as needed.
2. Add rel-keyed test-only next-body seam on EnsureGitHooksOptions; drive ensureGitHooks under forceTrackedReplace with enrolled+marker prior and marker-free next; assert downgrade conflict, no pre-push modify, exact prior bytes.
3. Add maybeSelfCompleteSetup e2e on git-init configured root: ran:true skipReason:null, preserve stderr disclosure, empty conflicts, readiness written, unchanged CUSTOM_PRE_PUSH-shaped tracked hook bytes.
4. CHANGELOG Unreleased Fixed for #5885.

items.title: P1 optional writeErr stderr disclose once-guard for preserved managed hooks

narrative.Acceptance: Given Prefer-A Recut-2 Bound 6393572833, when this clause ships, then: relieves: P1 — Optional writeErr on maybeSelfCompleteSetup (default process.stderr.write; hook-path tests drive run() directly with seams.writeErr) emits each formatTrackedHookPreserved line at most once per process keyed on the emitted preserved lines, with an exported once-guard reset for tests; never writeOut/stdout

items.title: P2 rel-keyed next-body seam forceTrackedReplace refuse-to-downgrade fixture

narrative.Acceptance: Given Prefer-A Recut-2 Bound 6393572833, when this clause ships, then: relieves: P2 — Rel-keyed test-only next-body seam on EnsureGitHooksOptions drives ensureGitHooks under forceTrackedReplace with enrolled+marker prior and marker-free next for that rel, asserting downgrade conflict, no pre-push modify, and exact prior bytes; pure predicate alone is not a substitute

items.title: P3 maybeSelfCompleteSetup e2e preserve disclosure readiness and hook bytes

narrative.Acceptance: Given Prefer-A Recut-2 Bound 6393572833, when this clause ships, then: relieves: P3 — maybeSelfCompleteSetup e2e on its own git-init configured root requires ran:true and skipReason:null first, then preserve stderr disclosure, empty conflicts, readiness written, and unchanged CUSTOM_PRE_PUSH-shaped tracked hook bytes (git add the hook; readiness starts missing/stale; unset hooksPath so activation can succeed)
